lead.headline: US coal power rose 85 terawatt-hours (13%) in 2025, about 1.8 times every other country's coal rise combined
lead.number: +84.99 TWh (+13.03%); the 23 other risers among 89 countries with 2025 data added 36.26 TWh (2.3x), about 1.8x once Ember's Asia residual for missing countries is added.
lead.watch_out: It is a rebound: 2023-24 lost 179 TWh when gas was cheap, and 2025 wins back 85 while staying 94 TWh below 2022. 105 countries, Indonesia included, have no 2025 data.
